request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-004: Monthly interest on a category balance

### given[0]: Interest is computed only when the rate found for this category balance (DIS-INT-RATE) is not zero. A zero rate skips the computation, so no transaction is written for that balance.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
>> 216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
>> 217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE
   220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF

### given[1]: The category balance is a signed amount with 9 integer digits and 2 decimals. The interest rate is a signed annual percentage with 4 integer digits and 2 decimals.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-BAL', 'DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CVTRA01Y.cpy:
     5            05  TRAN-CAT-KEY.
     6               10 TRANCAT-ACCT-ID                       PIC 9(11).
     7               10 TRANCAT-TYPE-CD                       PIC X(02).
     8               10 TRANCAT-CD                            PIC 9(04).
>>   9            05  TRAN-CAT-BAL                            PIC S9(09)V99.
    10            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(22).
    11       *
    12       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    13       *
CVTRA02Y.cpy:
     5            05  DIS-GROUP-KEY.
     6               10 DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID                     PIC X(10).
     7               10 DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD                      PIC X(02).
     8               10 DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD                       PIC 9(04).
>>   9            05  DIS-INT-RATE                            PIC S9(04)V99.
    10            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(28).
    11       *
    12       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    13       *

### given[2]: The running interest total is reset to 0 each time the account ID on the category balance record differs from the previous record's account ID.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 197                        ELSE
>> 198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
>> 199                        END-IF
>> 200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
   204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
   205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA

### when[0]: Monthly interest is computed as (category balance x interest rate) / 1200.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'TRAN-CAT-BAL', 'DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=['1200']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   460            EXIT.
   461       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   462        1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST.
   463 
>> 464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
>> 465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
   467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 

### then[0]: The result is stored in a signed field with 9 integer digits and 2 decimals. ROUNDED is not used, so extra decimals are truncated toward zero.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   164            06 DB2-MIL                   PIC 9(002).
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
   167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
>> 168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
   169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
CBACT04C.cbl:
   460            EXIT.
   461       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   462        1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST.
   463 
>> 464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
>> 465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
   467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 

### then[1]: The monthly interest is added to the account's running interest total, a signed field with 9 integer digits and 2 decimals.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'WS-TOTAL-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   463 
   464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
   465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
>> 467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
CBACT04C.cbl:
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
   167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
   168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.

### then[2]: One interest transaction record is then written for this category balance.
fields=[] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
   465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
   467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 
   472       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 214-217 perform 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST (and fees) only when DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0, so a zero rate skips the computation; the claim that no transaction is then written follows because the write is performed from within 1300 (line 468)."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"TRAN-CAT-BAL is PIC S9(09)V99 and DIS-INT-RATE is PIC S9(04)V99, matching the stated signed formats; the 'annual percentage' reading is consistent with the /1200 monthly divisor."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 194-201 set WS-TOTAL-INT to 0 whenever TRANCAT-ACCT-ID differs from WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM, which is then updated to the current account ID, so it holds the previous record's account."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 464-465 compute WS-MONTHLY-INT = (TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"WS-MONTHLY-INT is PIC S9(09)V99 and the COMPUTE omits ROUNDED, so excess decimal digits are truncated."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 467 adds WS-MONTHLY-INT to WS-TOTAL-INT, which line 169 declares as PIC S9(09)V99."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 468 performs 1300-B-WRITE-TX once per interest computation, writing the interest transaction for this category balance."}]}
